'''Colwyn Bay Football Club''' ({{langx|cy|Clwb Pêl-Droed Bae Colwyn}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Old Colwyn]] in North [[Wales]]. They are currently members of the {{Welsh football updater|ColwynB}}. Nicknamed the Seagulls, but also known as 'The Bay', their home ground is [[Llanelian Road]] in [[Old Colwyn]]."}}
